subject: English
passage: Using advanced ground-penetrating radar technology, a team of archaeologists surveyed the structural foundations of Temple Complex K23, one of several large ceremonial sites in an ancient Maya city. Surprisingly, the survey revealed foundation walls with completely irregular spacing and alignment. The researchers had expected the foundation layout to follow the precise geometric patterns seen in other temple complexes throughout the region.
prompt: According to the text, what was surprising about the researchers' survey of the foundation walls of Temple Complex K23?

choices.A: It showed foundation walls that were shallower than expected.
choices.B: It implied that previous surveys of the foundation walls were inaccurate.
choices.C: It produced structural measurements similar to those for other temple complexes.
choices.D: It revealed foundation walls that didn't follow geometric patterns.

explanation: Choice D is the best answer because it presents the point about the foundation survey that the text describes as surprising. The text indicates that a team of archaeologists surveyed the foundation walls of Temple Complex K23, and that the survey "surprisingly" revealed "completely irregular spacing and alignment" in the foundation walls. The text then adds that the researchers had thought the foundation layout would follow the precise geometric patterns of other temple complexes in the region. In other words, the researchers were surprised that the survey revealed foundation walls that didn't follow geometric patterns.
